theorems.name: Submission.simon_chart_tangentSpace_le_range_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ContinuousOn (Function.invFunOn ψ V) (W ∩ M) → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) ≤ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap
